text:
Ari (PM): quick final on the pilot playbook — want a compact set of rules we can share with invites tomorrow. open: slot rotation, micro-bounties for high-quality reports, timezone caps, what "actionable" means, probation timing, and a lightweight legal checkbox.

Ben (Eng): ops first: we can sustain 12 active slots if avg SE load <=2h/week. cap per high-touch partner 3h/week. we should limit KV warm-cache to a single 7-day window per partner and require an explicit opt-in checkbox. auto-teardown mandatory.

Soraya (CS): recruitment filter: live integration in last 90 days + named POC. scoring idea: usage(50), POC availability(30), strategic-fit(20). require POC timezone. add a "security approver" yes/no field to speed private deploys.

Eve (Design): to reduce friction: invite includes a "time commitment" pill (e.g., "~3h/week") and a one-line checklist (smoke test, kickoff, baseline form). feedback forms must be 3 questions max and include one binary "actionable in <=2 sprints?" question. recorded sessions optional.

Noah (Legal): minimal ask: checkbox "we consent to telemetry collection for pilot purposes" linking to one-paragraph addendum. if customer is regulated (health/finance) mark them high-compliance and run a short security intake — may add 7-14 days. avoid custom legal for SMBs.

Ari (PM): Draft program I'm proposing:
- Slots: 10 total (4 High-touch / 4 Low-touch / 2 Float)
- High-touch = ~3h/week expected, Low-touch = async forms (~1 every 2 weeks)
- SE cap = 12h/week total (max 3h/high-touch)
- KV warm-cache = opt-in, 7 day single window, auto-teardown
- Incentives: High-touch $1k credit + $250 micro-bounty if partner completes every required milestone in month 1; Low-touch $300 credit
- Replacement: miss 2 required milestone forms or 2 scheduled calls w/o reschedule -> probation notice -> 72h to respond -> if no action slot released to waitlist

Soraya (CS): waitlist behavior: pilot-bot should notify top 3 candidates simultaneously; first to accept within 48h gets the slot. show waitlist position in the email. also add a small "probation" email template.

pilot-bot: configured: on probation send notice -> 72h response window -> if no response mark slot released -> notify top 3 waitlist candidates with 48h accept window.

Ben (Eng): what counts as "actionable" = something we can scope and deliver in <=2 sprints without infra changes. add examples in the playbook. also tag all pilot traffic with pilot_slot_id and partner_id and isolate quotas for high-touch partners.

Eve (Design): measurement: track sentiment (-2..+2), feedback completion rate, avg response latency, and number of actionable items. surface per-slot on pilot dashboard and flag low engagement early.

Noah (Legal): addendum link + checkbox. also require a checkbox where partner confirms they have the right to share telemetry. for regulated partners add a security contact field.

Ari (PM): scheduling constraint: don't schedule >2 high-touch partners that need overlapping SE office-hours in the same 4-hour block. add timezone-cap column to the invite sheet.

Soraya (CS): recruitment email draft: "Short: invite to pilot Redwood Dedicated. High-touch asks ~3h/week (calls + short forms). Incentive: $1k credit + $250 micro-bounty for on-time feedback. Can you commit? Please share POC, timezone, and security approver."

Ben (Eng): rollback policy: if partner triggers regression that impacts other customers we will rollback partner changes immediately and pause the slot pending RCA; tag incidents with pilot_slot_id.

Ari (PM): I'll compile a 1-pager + spreadsheet and publish. final thumbs?

Eve (Design): :thumbsup:
Soraya (CS): :thumbsup:
Ben (Eng): :thumbsup:
Noah (Legal): :thumbsup:
Ari (PM): thanks — I'll send invites 09:00 PT tomorrow and wire pilot-bot to the sheet. ping me if anything blocks overnight.
